column1: # G0.4 stereo sources with distinct channels (review R6-05). Environment: simulator iPhone18,3, iOS 26.5 (23F77), Debug build, output at 1 % volume (quiet test runs). Budget: 500 ms.
# Stereo master: left = master-600s.wav [0, 300 s), right = master-long.wav [1400 s, 1700 s): different speech in each channel. Fixtures: Scripts/fixtures/generate-g04-audio-stereo.sh.

# err: content position minus intended position, ms (positive: the audio starts later in the source than intended). own: normalized correlation of a decoded or rendered channel with its own reference at that position; other: with the reference of the other channel (0: none of it).

# w_left/w_right: least-squares weights of the left and right references in mono audio made from the source (0.5/0.5: the average of the two channels). Expected: discrete stereo own >= 0.8, |other| <= 0.2 and weights 0.4-0.6; parametric stereo (HE-AAC v2): channel identity recorded, not judged, weights 0.25-1.0 (its one-channel core).

# same speech in both channels: the excerpt 121.37-151.37 s against the left reference (master-600s.wav). export_gain: least-squares gain of the decoded excerpt; export_peak_ratio: its peak over the peak of the source over the same span; system_1ch_gain: the same gain for the system two-to-one conversion of the source window (AVAssetReader asked for one channel). Expected: export_gain 0.95-1.05, export_peak_ratio at most 1.1.
